{{Quote|For several years, I worked for a claims-jumper outfit on several ore-rich worlds. We used one of these Fabritech 7000 Geoscanners to find the goods. We'd land on the planet at a likely spot, use the geoscanner to find a promising lode and get to work. Between that and our super-borer, we could open a rich vein and pack it in the hold before sector officials even had a clue we were there.|[[Narseri]]|<ref name="Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>}}
The '''7000 Geoscanner''' was a [[Geoscanner/Legends|geoscanner]] manufactured by [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]]. It could detect geological characteristics like precious [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]], [[Ore/Legends|ore]] deposits and underground features, as well as analyzing geothermal, seismic, [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]], and glacial activity. It was commonly used by [[Miner/Legends|miners]] and [[Prospector/Legends|prospectors]].<ref name="Scanners" />
